description: A Python script designed to sanitize and validate BitBake recipe files (.bb) according to OpenEmbedded style guidelines. It processes lines, enforces formatting rules, and outputs a cleaned version of the input file.

methods.name: respect_rule0
methods.description: Checks if a line has no leading spaces, adhering to style rule 0.

methods.name: conformTo_rule0
methods.description: Removes leading spaces from a line to conform to style rule 0.

methods.name: respect_rule1
methods.description: Ensures no spaces follow a line continuation backslash.

methods.name: conformTo_rule1
methods.description: Removes trailing spaces to conform to style rule 1.

methods.name: respect_rule2
methods.description: Checks that no tabs are used in a line.

methods.name: respect_rule3
methods.description: Checks if a line is a comment starting with '#'.

methods.name: conformTo_rule3
methods.description: Lints comment lines by stripping leading spaces.

methods.name: respect_rule4
methods.description: Verifies that variable assignments use quotes on the right side.

methods.name: conformTo_rule4
methods.description: Ensures variable assignments are formatted as FOO = "BAR".

methods.name: respect_rule5
methods.description: Checks for proper spacing around assignment operators.

methods.name: conformTo_rule5
methods.description: Formats assignment lines with correct spacing: FOO = "BAR".

methods.name: respect_rule6
methods.description: Ensures no spaces or tabs on empty lines.

methods.name: conformTo_rule6
methods.description: Returns an empty string for empty lines.

methods.name: respect_rule7
methods.description: Checks indentation for multiline variables (always true here).

methods.name: follow_rule
methods.description: Checks and enforces style rules on a line, printing warnings or reminders if rules are violated.
